title: إسرائيل تصادق على بناء مئات الوحدات الاستيطانية الجديدة في الضفة الغربية
content: منحت الحكومة الإسرائيلية موافقة نهائية لبناء نحو 800 وحدة استيطانية جديدة في الضفة الغربية المحتلة، في خطوة اعتبرتها السلطة الفلسطينية تقويضاً لجهود السلام ودعت إدارة الرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترامب لوقفها. الإعلان جاء على لسان وزير المالية بتسلئيل سموتريتش، الذي كشف عن إقرار أكثر من 51 ألف وحدة منذ توليه المنصب في 2022، وسط رفض فلسطيني ودولي لأنشطة الاستيطان التي تعدها الأمم المتحدة غير قانونية، وفي ظل تصاعد اعتداءات المستوطنين لأعلى معدل شهري منذ 2006.

title: María Corina Machado Appears in Norway After Missing Nobel Ceremony
content: María Corina Machado, who spent over a year in hiding in Venezuela, greeted supporters in Oslo, hours after her daughter accepted the Nobel Peace Prize in her name.

title: Former King Juan Carlos I of Spain, Seeking Relevance, Publishes Book
content: King Juan Carlos I of Spain abdicated and left for exile years ago. Now, his attempted comeback is giving his family a royal headache.

title: Mexico Approves 50% Tariffs on Many Chinese Imports
content: The tariffs will apply to goods from China and other nations. Washington has been pressuring Mexico to move away from dealing with China.

title: Khmer Rouge-Era Land Mines Have a Big Role in Thailand-Cambodia Conflict
content: Thailand says ordnance replanted by Cambodia has injured or maimed more than a dozen of its soldiers. Cambodia rejects the accusation.

title: Venezuela’s Nobel Peace Prize Winner Raises Stakes in Stand off With Maduro
content: The decision by María Corina Machado, the Venezuelan opposition leader, to emerge from hiding and leave the country has electrified her movement but carries political risks.

title: Louvre Heist Was Caught on Film, Officials Say, Rebutting Earlier Account
content: Investigators said that a security camera recorded thieves preparing to burgle the Louvre. The museum’s director said previously that the camera was facing the wrong way.

title: Yemeni Separatists Set Sights on Houthi-Controlled Capital
content: The Southern Transitional Council has seized control of parts of Yemen over the past week, with ambitions to create a “south Arabian state.”

title: Britain Releases New Data on ‘Grooming Gangs’ and Child Sexual Abuse
content: The police in Britain warned that the threat from online predators has been rising while political attention has been focused elsewhere.

title: Lawsuit Challenges Park Service Passes Featuring Trump
content: An environmental group is suing, saying federal law requires an image of public lands, not the president.

title: M23 Rebels Seize Uvira in Eastern Congo
content: The fighting in Congo continues despite Washington’s claims to have brokered an end to the conflict.

title: A Controversial Nobel Peace Prize
content: The Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado supports the use of force to overthrow her country’s government.

title: Trump Says U.S. Seized Oil Tanker Off Venezuelan Coast
content: The seizure comes as the United States builds up its forces in the Caribbean as part of a campaign against President Nicolás Maduro of Venezuela.

title: U.S. Plans to Scrutinize 5 Years of Social Media History for Foreign Tourists
content: Even visitors from countries like Britain and France, whose citizens don’t need visas, would have to share five years’ worth of social media.

title: A History of U.S. Military Action in Latin America
content: The United States’ history in the region includes several about-faces, contradictions and missteps.
